recommendation: Keep the FHIR-core audit as-is. If the migrated THO SNOMED CT page should align its operation label exactly with the normative descendent-of spelling, handle that as a THO/UTG follow-up rather than a FHIR-core source edit.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 Vocabulary issue asking the SNOMED CT filters page to document support for the FHIR descendent-of ValueSet filter operator matching SNOMED CT ECL < descendantOf semantics.
initial_application: The 2020-11-12 Vocab WG minutes approved adding descendent-of to the SNOMED CT filter page, and git commit b0172dd266bc5061422826c714e77a6d3c559296 applied the R5 change by adding an ECL < subsumption table to source/snomedct.html.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed source/snomedct.html from FHIR core and moved external terminology usage guidance to THO. Current source/terminologies-systems.html links SNOMED CT guidance to terminology.hl7.org, source/hierarchy.xml keeps only the SNOMED CT Usage Summary locally, and the active filter-operator CodeSystem already defines the normative descendent-of operator with its compatibility spelling note. The current THO page contains the ECL < semantics but is outside this checkout.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. Reintroducing or duplicating the removed local SNOMED CT filters page in FHIR core would conflict with the later THO migration, so any remaining exact page-label cleanup belongs in THO/UTG.
